payload.content:
name: cloud-secret-cross-project
description: Synthetic ownership, identity and secret-state description. Evidence
  references are illustrative. This example makes no cloud deployment or access proof
  claim.
nodes:
  worker:
    type: compute
  iam:
    type: compute
    runtime:
      identity_authorities:
      - identity_authority_id: cloud
        kind: cloud_iam
        subjects:
        - subject_id: worker
          kind: service_account
          name: worker
          resource_scope_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.resource_scopes.project-a
        - subject_id: requester
          kind: user
          name: requester
          resource_scope_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.resource_scopes.project-a
        policies:
        - policy_id: reader
          policy_kind: access
          resource_access:
            attachment_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.resource_scopes.project-b
            bindings:
            - binding_id: metadata
              principal_refs:
              - nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.worker
              resource_refs:
              - nodes.secrets.runtime.platform_applications.manager.secrets.database
              actions:
              - secretmanager.secrets.get
              effect: allow
            - binding_id: read
              principal_refs:
              - nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.worker
              resource_refs:
              - nodes.secrets.runtime.platform_applications.manager.secrets.database
              actions:
              - secretmanager.versions.access
              effect: allow
        - policy_id: identity-use
          policy_kind: access
          resource_access:
            attachment_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.worker
            bindings:
            - binding_id: impersonate
              principal_refs:
              - nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.requester
              resource_refs:
              - nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.worker
              actions:
              - iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken
              effect: allow
        - policy_id: inherited-secret
          policy_kind: access
          resource_access:
            attachment_ref: nodes.secrets.runtime.platform_applications.manager.secrets.database
            inherited_from_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.policies.reader
        resource_scopes:
        - scope_id: project-a
          provider: gcp
          scope_kind: project
          native_id: project-a
        - scope_id: project-b
          provider: gcp
          scope_kind: project
          native_id: project-b
        identity_uses:
        - use_id: worker-use
          workload_ref: nodes.worker
          principal_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.worker
          mode: impersonated
          source_principal_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.requester
        access_observations:
        - observation_id: metadata-read
          principal_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.worker
          action: secretmanager.secrets.get
          resource_ref: nodes.secrets.runtime.platform_applications.manager.secrets.database
          outcome: allowed
          evidence_refs:
          - urn:example:metadata-attempt
        - observation_id: denied-version
          principal_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.subjects.worker
          action: secretmanager.versions.access
          resource_ref: nodes.secrets.runtime.platform_applications.manager.secrets.database.versions.v2
          outcome: denied
          evidence_refs:
          - urn:example:denied-attempt
  secrets:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 443
      protocol: tcp
      name: api
    runtime:
      platform_applications:
      - platform_application_id: manager
        service: api
        product: GCP Secret Manager
        secrets:
        - secret_id: database
          resource_scope_ref: nodes.iam.runtime.identity_authorities.cloud.resource_scopes.project-b
          native_id: database
          versions:
          - version_id: v1
            native_id: '1'
            state: enabled
          - version_id: v2
            native_id: '2'
            state: disabled
          - version_id: v3
            native_id: '3'
            state: destroyed
          consumers:
          - selection_id: exact-version
            consumer_ref: nodes.worker
            version_ref: nodes.secrets.runtime.platform_applications.manager.secrets.database.versions.v2
          - selection_id: alias-report
            consumer_ref: nodes.worker
            selector:
              kind: alias
              value: latest
            resolved_version_ref: nodes.secrets.runtime.platform_applications.manager.secrets.database.versions.v1
            resolution_basis: observed
            resolution_evidence_refs:
            - urn:example:alias-resolution
